title: Real-time data analysis to cut downtime at gold mines
summary: At its Cadia gold mine, Newcrest uses redundant PI servers and model-driven virtual sensors to keep the crushing circuit running when physical sensors fail.
challenge: There was no real-time data, and underground sensors are hard to reach and maintain.
solution: A scalable, redundant PI architecture with model-driven virtual sensors.

outcomes.text: Throughput up 650,000 tons in the first six months

title: Striking copper and gold: how data increased Ok Tedi's recovery rates
summary: Ok Tedi worked with integrator Mipac on a data-driven recovery strategy using PI System, AVEVA Production Management and AVEVA Plant SCADA.
challenge: Declining ore grades, process instability and low trust in process control.
solution: PI-based process improvement with integrator Mipac.

outcomes.reportedBy: Mipac (integrator article on a talk by Daniel Qiao)
Mipac (integrator article on a talk by Daniel Qiao)

title: Remote monitoring and data analytics using the PI System at HZL
summary: Hindustan Zinc runs machine-learning soft sensors for P80 particle size and sulphide sulphur, tracks process deviations with event frames, and monitors fleet health on PI System.
challenge: The presentation mentions "very unique challenges" and a dependence on lab results and online analysers.
solution: Machine-learning soft sensors trained on historical PI data, fed with live PI data, and written back to PI and the DCS every 5 minutes.

outcomes.text: P80 soft sensor at about 95% accuracy, eliminating the need for 6 online particle size analysers
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Pradeep Mahajan, HZL) in an AVEVA PI World 2021 presentation

outcomes.text: Sulphide sulphur soft sensor at about 90% accuracy
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Pradeep Mahajan, HZL) in an AVEVA PI World 2021 presentation

title: The PI System at the heart of a Mining Integrated Remote Operations Center
summary: ArcelorMittal Mining Canada (AMMC) uses PI as the data hub of its Integrated Remote Operations Center, with a 3-level operations management system that runs from a whole-mine view down to equipment dashboards.
challenge: AMMC had to integrate fleet management, mine plan, DCS/PLC, rail and port data.
solution: Two PI Servers (about 140,000 points) with AF, Analytics, Event Frames, Notifications, PI Vision, DataLink and Manual Logger, plus a 90-day optimisation sprint.

outcomes.text: Mine plan conformity increased by an additional 5%
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Plourde, AMMC) in a PI World 2019 presentation

outcomes.text: Concentrator slowdowns from low crusher feed "reduced by 300%"
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Plourde, AMMC) in a PI World 2019 presentation

verifyNote: The "reduced by 300%" figure is mathematically unclear (a reduction cannot exceed 100%). Verify with the author before teaching it.

title: Improving environmental regulation compliance with better data management
summary: Barrick Goldstrike uses PI AF and Analytics to automate air-quality permit compliance reporting under three Air Quality Operating Permits.
challenge: Three Air Quality Operating Permits, manual field logs and interdependent spreadsheets made reporting slow and error-prone.
solution: AF and Analytics compute the maximum or minimum hourly averages needed for the permits; PI Coresight and PI DataLink present the results.

outcomes.text: Interim spreadsheets removed from compliance reporting (no figures given)

title: Responsible mining with data
summary: Vale, working with Accenture, centralised data from 35 environmental monitoring stations on PI System, with PI Vision dashboards and PI DataLink compliance reports.
challenge: Environmental compliance reporting was slow and field trips carried risk.
solution: PI Vision dashboards and PI DataLink compliance reports over centralised station data.

outcomes.text: Field trips cut from 600km to 200km on average per month
Air quality reporting cut from 5h20 to two minutes
Data updates from seven days to five minutes
Station integration from one month to three days

title: Alcoa transforms its approach to maintenance
summary: Alcoa matches PI sensor data with Oracle eAM maintenance records to estimate the remaining useful life of equipment.
challenge: Alcoa needed to integrate PI history with its Oracle eAM maintenance system.
solution: Sensor data matched with maintenance history to predict remaining useful life.

title: Streamlining data at every stage of the mining value chain
summary: Rio Tinto's aluminium business layered AVEVA Production Management on its "widely used" PI System to track downtime and losses.
challenge: The in-house downtime tracking system had fallen out of use.
solution: AVEVA Production Management running on top of PI System data.
